plan_approval.meaning: The overseer explicitly requested execution; do not stop solely for human plan approval if the selected workflow can consume this grant.

existing_plan_candidates.meaning: If non-empty, these plan artifacts already existed before this process invocation. Reuse/update the latest matching plan; do not create a second plan unless every candidate is stale or mismatched, in which case escalate instead of exporting.

delivery.command_template: Lathe exports committed task changes across the .latheignore boundary; do not push this branch directly to source.head_branch.
